name: io.github.Perufitlife/pocketbase-security-mcp
description: Audit and fix PocketBase API rules from inside any MCP-compatible AI agent. Detects empty rules, over-permissive @request.auth.id != "" grants, dangerous true literals. Active anonymous probe confirms each leak live.

environmentVariables.name: POCKETBASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your PocketBase instance

environmentVariables.name: POCKETBASE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: PocketBase admin password (used only for the audit run, never persisted)
